tasks.title: Epic 1 API Endpoints - Job Mapping
tasks.description: Create REST API endpoints for geolocation job mapping functionality
tasks.details:
COMPLETED: Implemented comprehensive Epic 1 Job Mapping API endpoints including:

**Models Created:**
- Job: Complete job listing model with company, location, salary, skills
- JobApplication: User job application tracking
- SavedJob: User saved jobs functionality
- JobAlert: Customizable job alerts with email notifications
- Skill: Skills database with categories and proficiency levels
- UserSkill: User skill profiles with experience tracking
- JobSkill: Job-skill requirements mapping

**API Endpoints Implemented:**
- Job CRUD operations (list, detail, create, update)
- Advanced job search with filters (keywords, location, salary, type, etc.)
- Geolocation-based job search with radius filtering
- Nearby jobs API with coordinate-based search
- Job map visualization data endpoint
- Save/unsave jobs functionality
- Job application system
- Job alerts management
- Skills management (CRUD)
- User skills profile management

**Features:**
- Pagination for all list endpoints
- Advanced filtering and search capabilities
- Geolocation distance calculations (Haversine formula)
- Permission-based access control
- Django admin interface
- Both class-based and function-based views for flexibility
- Comprehensive serializers with validation
- Database migrations completed

**Technical Implementation:**
- RESTful API design following Django REST Framework best practices
- Proper error handling and validation
- Optimized database queries with select_related and prefetch_related
- UUID-based primary keys for security
- Comprehensive indexing for performance
- Activity logging integration

All Epic 1 job mapping functionality is now fully implemented and ready for frontend integration.
tasks.testStrategy: API endpoint testing, geolocation accuracy tests
